claims.note: This reference describes a system for robotic-based framing in construction, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device or a suction plate.

This reference describes robotic systems and their components, such as multifunctional end effectors with grippers and nail guns, but not a housing with a grip portion for a hand-operated device or an electrically operated vacuum generating device in that context.
This reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
This reference does not describe exhaust air from a vacuum generating device being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
This reference describes robotic systems for construction framing, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device with a sound-damping device in the grip portion.
This reference describes robotic systems for construction framing, not a grip unit with a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
This reference describes robotic systems for construction framing, not a grip unit with a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
This reference describes robotic systems for construction framing, not a grip unit with a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.
This reference does not discuss a grip unit, housing portions, or air outlets.
This reference does not discuss a grip unit, air collection devices, or exhaust air.
This reference does not discuss a grip unit, housing portions, air baffles, or exhaust air.
This reference does not discuss a grip unit, battery coupling points, electrical energy storage devices, or rechargeable batteries.
This reference does not discuss air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
This reference describes a system for robotic-based framing, not a vacuum handling apparatus.
This reference does not disclose a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to it.
This reference does not describe a grip unit as defined in claim 1 of the subject invention.
This reference does not disclose a vacuum handling apparatus, grip unit, suction plate, or coupling device.
This reference does not disclose a vacuum handling apparatus, grip unit, suction opening, suction chamber, or suction plate.
